---
title: "Downloads"
title-tr: "İndirmeler"
description: "The full Excel workbook for each crop, rebuilt on every weekly refresh, with the as-of date, what each sheet holds and the source credits."
description-tr: "Her ürünün tam Excel çalışma kitabı; her haftalık güncellemede yeniden hazırlanır ve verilerin tarihini, her sayfanın içeriğini ve kaynak atıflarını içerir."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site import workbook
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.crops import crop_module
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t

crops = load_crops()
ph.raw_html(
    f'<div class="dash-head"><div><span class="eyebrow">{ph.escape(t("downloads.eyebrow"))}</span>'
    f'<h1>{ph.escape(t("downloads.h1"), quote=False)}</h1></div></div>'
)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
::: {.lede .explorer-lede}
Each crop's workbook holds the site's main tables in one formatted Excel file; its sheets are listed below. It is rebuilt on every weekly refresh. To take only some months, filter them in the crop's data explorer and download that view.
:::
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="tr"}
::: {.lede .explorer-lede}
Her ürünün çalışma kitabı, sitenin ana tablolarını biçimlendirilmiş tek bir Excel dosyasında toplar; sayfaları aşağıda listeleniyor. Çalışma kitabı her haftalık güncellemede yeniden hazırlanır. Yalnızca bazı ayları almak isterseniz, o ürünün veri gezgininde ayları filtreleyip o görünümü indirin.
:::
:::

```{python}
for crop in crops.values():
    mod = crop_module(crop.slug)
    name = workbook.workbook_filename(crop.slug)  # this language's file
    path = SITE_DIR / "downloads" / name
    size = path.stat().st_size if path.is_file() else None  # CI builds it before rendering
    manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "manifest.json")
    stamp = ""
    if manifest is not None:
        stamp = (f'<span class="live"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>'
                 f"{ph.escape(ph.as_of_stamp(manifest))}</span>")
    explorer = ""
    if "explorer" in crop.sections:
        explorer = (f'<a class="btn" href="{ph.escape(crop.slug)}/explorer.qmd">'
                    f"{ph.escape(t('downloads.filter_link'), quote=False)} {ph.ARROW}</a>")
    label = i18n.crop_name(crop)
    ph.raw_html(
        '<div class="dash downloads">'
        f'<section class="panel span-8" aria-labelledby="wb-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'<span class="eyebrow">{ph.escape(label)} · {ph.escape(i18n.crop_country(crop))}</span>'
        f'<h2 class="ptitle" id="wb-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'{ph.escape(t("downloads.workbook_title", crop=label), quote=False)}</h2>'
        f'<div class="sub">{ph.escape(t("downloads.workbook_sub"), quote=False)}</div>'
        f'<div class="dl-meta">{ph.workbook_download_html(f"downloads/{name}", size)}{explorer}{stamp}</div>'
        f"{ph.sheet_list_html(workbook.sheet_list(crop.slug))}"
        "</section>"
        f'<section class="panel span-4 soon" aria-labelledby="pbi-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'<span class="pill">{ph.escape(t("downloads.coming_later"))}</span>'
        f'<h2 class="ptitle" id="pbi-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'{ph.escape(t("downloads.powerbi_title"), quote=False)}</h2>'
        f'<div class="sub">{ph.escape(t("downloads.powerbi_sub"), quote=False)}</div>'
        "</section>"
        f'<section class="panel span-12" aria-labelledby="src-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'<h2 class="ptitle" id="src-{ph.escape(crop.slug)}">'
        f'{ph.escape(t("downloads.sources_title"), quote=False)}</h2>'
        f'<div class="sub">{ph.escape(t("downloads.sources_sub", crop=i18n.lower(label)), quote=False)}</div>'
        f"{ph.sources_table_html(mod.WORKBOOK_SOURCES)}"
        f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(t("downloads.sources_foot"), quote=False)}</p>'
        "</section>"
        "</div>"
    )
```
